matching_method_note: The first report calculates the eight Ashtakoota categories from Moon sign and Nakshatra. Full planetary, Manglik and Dosha checks are not included until the complete chart engine is validated.
matching_report_scope: This report calculates the eight Ashtakoota categories using Moon sign and Nakshatra data. Individual D1 placements are displayed for reference, but they are not yet used to calculate Manglik Dosha, planetary aspects, Lagna compatibility or Dosha cancellation. The scoring uses a documented baseline table; regional traditions can differ.
matching_boundary_warning: One or both Moon positions are close to a Nakshatra or Pada boundary. Small birth-time or ephemeris differences may change the matching result. Verify both birth details independently.

p_detail_nakshatra: The 27 Nakshatras divide the sidereal zodiac into equal segments of 13°20′.
p_detail_yoga: Calculated from the sum of the sidereal longitudes of the Sun and Moon.
p_detail_karana: A karana is half of a tithi; seven movable and four fixed karanas are used.

koota_varna_explanation: Varna compares traditional classifications of the Moon signs. This baseline applies the conventional groom-equal-or-higher rule; it is a traditional scoring convention, not a measure of personal worth.
koota_vashya_explanation: Vashya compares traditional sign groups associated with mutual influence. Sign groups are used as a baseline; regional tables and boundary conventions can differ.
koota_tara_explanation: Tara evaluates the distance between the two birth Nakshatras in both directions. Sampat, Kshema, Sadhaka, Mitra and Parama Mitra are treated as favorable in this scoring convention.
koota_yoni_explanation: Yoni compares traditional animal symbols assigned to Nakshatras. This baseline awards full points for the same animal, zero for listed enemy pairs and partial points otherwise; regional tables may differ.
koota_graha_maitri_explanation: Graha Maitri compares natural friendship between lords of the two Moon signs. This baseline does not include temporary planetary relationships from full birth charts.
koota_gana_explanation: Gana compares traditional temperament groups of the birth Nakshatras: Deva, Manushya and Rakshasa. This is a commonly used baseline; some traditions apply gender-sensitive variations.
koota_bhakoot_explanation: Bhakoot compares the Moon-sign distance. Conventional 2/12, 5/9 and 6/8 relationships receive zero points in this baseline. Cancellation rules and regional interpretations are not evaluated.
koota_nadi_explanation: Nadi compares Adi, Madhya and Antya classifications assigned to Nakshatras. This score does not apply Nadi Dosha cancellation rules or exceptions, which require additional traditional checks.
